cards.card_text: The passage tallies the gold: one gold tumor for each Philistine city, Ashdod, Gaza, Ashkelon, Gath and Ekron, and gold rats to match the cities of the five rulers, the fortified cities and their outlying villages.
cards.verse_text: The number of gold rats also corresponded to the number of Philistine cities belonging to the five rulers—the fortified cities and their outlying villages.
